# Exploratory data analysis


1. Relationship betweet weight and mpg

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Figure 1: Scatterplot"
#| echo: true
data(mtcars)
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=mpg, y=wt)) + geom_point()
```

According to the Figure 1 there is negative non-linear relationship between weight and mpg.
